panels.title: Decisions per second, by outcome
panels.description: BLOCK/RESTRICT/ALLOW rate. A sudden shift in the ALLOW:BLOCK ratio is the first thing worth noticing on this dashboard.

panels.title: Decision source breakdown (which stage decided)
panels.description: cache/fast_path_*/fusion_*/*_judge_* — shows the fast/deep cascade (§1v) actually working: fast_path_* firing means fusion was skipped for that request.

panels.title: End-to-end request latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: §1p/§1v measured cold p50 ~1.0s, p95 double-digit seconds (judge-dominated) -- this panel is where that shows up live rather than in a one-off benchmark log.

panels.title: Per-stage latency, p95
panels.description: meta_intent / faiss_threat_search / domain_alignment / fusion. Fusion should dominate -- if another stage suddenly doesn't, something regressed.

panels.title: Assessments in flight
panels.description: Sustained values at/above ASSESS_MAX_CONCURRENCY (default 4) mean requests are queueing -- the leading indicator before the 30s timeout starts firing.

panels.title: Rate-limited requests (429s)
panels.description: Anonymous overage is ordinary; sustained authenticated=true overage usually means a client-side bug worth chasing, not abuse.

panels.title: Assessment timeouts (503s)
panels.description: Should be near zero in steady state. A timeout is an availability event -- see docs/ENGINEERING_ASSESSMENT.md §1q for why it returns 503 rather than a fabricated verdict.

panels.title: Judge invocation rate
panels.description: §1v measured this at ~6.6% of traffic on the reference benchmark -- the ambiguous zone is meant to be the exception, not the common case.

panels.title: Circuit breaker state
panels.description: 1 = open (failing fast). ollama_judge and llama_guard tracked separately -- see core/circuit_breaker.py.

panels.title: Unrecognised decision sources (should be ~0)
panels.description: Non-zero means core/risk.py emits a verdict source core/metrics.py's KNOWN_SOURCES allowlist doesn't recognise yet -- the metric degraded, not the gateway. See core/metrics.py's cardinality-guard docstring.

panels.title: Assessments per tenant
panels.description: Per-tenant traffic and decision mix -- §1s/§1t made tenant load-bearing for suspension, SLA, and policy; this is where that becomes visible operationally.
